en.headline: Space Museum launches Wild Asia dome show from Wednesday
en.dek: The 43-minute presentation runs until June 2027 and follows wildlife surviving in the Himalayas, Gobi Desert and Pacific depths.
body: The Hong Kong Space Museum will begin screening its new dome show Wild Asia: Life at Extremes at the Space Theatre from Wednesday 16 September.

The 43-minute film takes audiences across extreme Asian habitats, tracking species including the snow leopard in the high Himalayas, the long-eared jerboa in the Gobi Desert and deep-sea sea bunnies. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the production highlights the adaptability of wildlife under harsh conditions.

Screenings run at 5pm on weekdays and at 11am, 3.30pm and 8pm on weekends and public holidays. The show continues until 14 June 2027. Tickets cost HK$30 for front stalls and HK$40 for stalls and are available at the museum box office and URBTIX.
The Space Museum in Tsim Sha Tsui is closed on Tuesdays except public holidays. Selected sessions offer English audio; a headphone system provides Cantonese, Putonghua and English.

zh.headline: 太空館周三起放映球幕電影《極境亞洲之生命奇跡》
zh.dek: 43分鐘影片展至2027年6月，帶領觀眾認識喜馬拉雅、戈壁及深海中的野生動物求生故事。
body: 香港太空館天象廳將於周三（9月16日）起推出全新球幕電影《極境亞洲之生命奇跡》。
片長43分鐘的影片帶領觀眾走進亞洲極端環境，包括喜馬拉雅山脈的雪豹、戈壁沙漠的長耳跳鼠，以及深海的碎毛盤海蛞蝓，展示野生動物如何在險境中適應求生。
放映時間為平日下午5時，周末及公眾假期則為上午11時、下午3時半及晚上8時，展期至2027年6月14日。票價前座30元、後座40元，現於太空館票房及城市售票網發售。
太空館位於尖沙咀，逢星期二休館（公眾假期除外）。部分場次設英語旁白，耳機系統提供粵語、普通話及英語選擇。
